scope: Historical 613-entry discovery ledger. Owner ended expansion on 2026-09-09 at 124 native UI entries; unfinished reference comparisons are deferred. Verified core adaptation is not exact source/API/visual parity.
releaseBoundary: Publish existing 124 UI entries with owner approval on 2026-09-09. No additional cloning is planned or authorized in this release.

entries.sourceName: Card stack with gsap and rotate

adaptation.coreBehavior: Four demonstration scenes: Number Flow countdown with pause/reset; spring-based in-view 500; twelve random poses ending at 2146000; in-view Number Flow with prefix/suffix.
adaptation.originalDesign: A reusable value-driven span instead of timers or random data. Callers own countdown state; from supplies a one-time visible entrance. Twelve deterministic poses convey a drawn count without inventing random financial values.
differences: Native reusable UI interpretation; no claim of upstream API/timeline/visual parity.

adaptation.coreBehavior: Directional underline reveals from either reading edge or center, and vertical/horizontal background fills on link interaction.
adaptation.originalDesign: Original organic ink paths and restrained pigment washes; native anchors, arriving arrow exchange, keyboard emphasis, RTL and shared quiet settings.
differences: Source uses straight CSS underlines and blend inversion; native treats them as ink contours and a translucent palette wash to preserve text contrast.
Native motion shares SahaJiv choreography rather than fixed source CSS timing.

adaptation.coreBehavior: Public Pro preview uses a transparent type=text input under separately animated glyphs. Decimal/negative text and first-character replacement were exercised; a 20-digit string overflows the 390px preview.
adaptation.originalDesign: A real composed numeric spinbutton role was missing from Input: localized draft editing, stepping, min/max, native form submission/reset and formatted idle display. During focus the genuine input text/caret/selection remain visible. Only idle changes roll; the source transparent editing layer is deliberately not reproduced.
differences: Native reusable UI interpretation; no claim of upstream API/timeline/visual parity.

adaptation.coreBehavior: Pro preview Shuffle changes independently moving digits and formatted signs, grouping, fractions, percent and suffixes. Pointer and Enter activation observed at desktop/mobile.
adaptation.originalDesign: Intl.NumberFormat options retain native currency/percent/grouping/scientific formatting. Only numeric runs roll; locale punctuation remains literal. Numeric runs keep LTR digit order inside actual RTL ancestors.
differences: Native reusable UI interpretation; no claim of upstream API/timeline/visual parity.

adaptation.coreBehavior: Character opacity and blur resolve over 27 frames; upward travel resolves over 9 frames; one-frame character stagger. Array.from splits code points, including spaces.
adaptation.originalDesign: Existing soften/grapheme entrance reused. Native blur is 5px with font-relative travel and shared easing, and grapheme clusters stay intact; long delay is distributed evenly.

adaptation.coreBehavior: Sharp character rise: 21-frame fade, 10-frame 32px upward travel, one-frame stagger, no blur.
adaptation.originalDesign: Existing rise/grapheme entrance reused. Native cadence and distance differ; Unicode segmentation and bounded long-text sequence improve application use.

adaptation.coreBehavior: Character staircase from +46px: 12-frame fade, 7-frame travel, default three-frame stagger.
adaptation.originalDesign: Existing direction and stagger controls express the upward staircase. Native travel stays smaller and font-relative; long sequences compress evenly rather than leaving a simultaneous tail.

adaptation.coreBehavior: Character staircase from -46px, otherwise the same 12-frame fade, 7-frame travel and three-frame stagger as Bottom-Up Letters.
adaptation.originalDesign: Existing downward direction reused; focused runtime confirms opposite vertical sign. Native distance/cadence are intentionally different.

adaptation.coreBehavior: Words split on ASCII spaces scale from 0.7 to 1 with an overshooting cubic easing over 11 frames, default three-frame stagger. Actual sampled scale reached 1.02893.
adaptation.originalDesign: New bloom entrance uses original finite keyframes 0.86 → 1.025 → 1, shared settle easing and inherited unit duration/delay. Whitespace stays actual text instead of fixed margins.

adaptation.coreBehavior: A single complete phrase fades and scales from 0.96 to 1 over 18 frames; no exit.
adaptation.originalDesign: New scale entrance and whole-phrase split fill a real gap. Native duration remains configurable; text can wrap naturally.

adaptation.coreBehavior: Whole phrase enters over 16 frames with +8px travel and scale 1.04 → 1; scheduled final 11-frame fade/shrink/upward exit uses video duration. Frontmatter incorrectly calls it entrance-only; body and source include exit.
adaptation.originalDesign: A 1.04-to-rest arrival and 0.94 upward shrinking exit. Native caller-controlled removal with 420ms exit, optional sibling exitDelay, retained DOM and quiet-state removal.
differences: Interaction-driven lifecycle rather than a video duration; SahaJiv blur/travel/easing amplitudes. Exact source timing and API parity are not claimed.

adaptation.coreBehavior: Words enter with 6px blur, +10px travel and fade, despite clean-entry wording in docs; near clip end, words fade, blur to 8px, then move up to -14px with stagger.
adaptation.originalDesign: Word-level softened rise and staggered upward blurred departure. Native caller-controlled removal with 420ms exit, optional sibling exitDelay, retained DOM and quiet-state removal.
differences: Interaction-driven lifecycle rather than a video duration; SahaJiv blur/travel/easing amplitudes. Exact source timing and API parity are not claimed.

adaptation.coreBehavior: Whole phrase resolves 14px blur, opacity, +14px travel and 1.01 → 1 scale over 23 frames; final 16-frame exit fades with blur to 10px and -10px travel.
adaptation.originalDesign: Whole-phrase depth/focus arrival and upward defocused exit. Native caller-controlled removal with 420ms exit, optional sibling exitDelay, retained DOM and quiet-state removal.
differences: Interaction-driven lifecycle rather than a video duration; SahaJiv blur/travel/easing amplitudes. Exact source timing and API parity are not claimed.

adaptation.coreBehavior: Pinned source calculates turns independently for each decimal place, faster lower places, leading-place rise/reveal and exact landing. Its registry scene is nonnegative integers on a Remotion timeline.
adaptation.originalDesign: A bounded wheel per changed place and a small leading-place reveal preserve readable digit motion on live UI updates, including downward and interrupted changes. The native treatment does not reproduce giant full-turn counts or fixed video timing.
differences: Native reusable UI interpretation; no claim of upstream API/timeline/visual parity.

adaptation.coreBehavior: Pinned source quantizes count timing, redraws each glyph with seeded rotation/vertical pose, supports toFixed decimal prefix/suffix, and freezes on its exact target in a Caveat scene.

differences: Native reusable UI interpretation; no claim of upstream API/timeline/visual parity.
